replaces.idea: A squat cast-iron bench press with two top input levers that stamp down to pop a single spring-loaded output plunger on the right.
A small upright brass-and-slate mechanical flip-card box with a side crank and a hinged front shutter that snaps open on each tick.
A compact benchtop logic analyzer with a recessed CRT screen showing two stepped square-wave traces and three probe jacks.
A floor-mounted railway-style signal switch box with two input rails on the left, a selector lever on top, and one output rail on the right.
A tall four-column mechanical carry abacus on a flat base with beads pushed up and a single overflow carry bead tipped at the top-left.

new.name: NAND Press
new.depicts: A squat cast-iron bench press bolted to a floor plate, with two vertical input levers on top, a heavy stamping die in the middle, and a single spring-loaded output plunger sticking out the right side.
new.focal: the two top levers pressing down to pop the side plunger

new.name: Clocked Latch
new.depicts: A small upright brass-and-slate mechanical flip-card box on four stubby feet, with a side crank handle and a hinged front shutter that snaps open to show a single lit tile.
new.focal: the hinged shutter snapping open on the side crank's tick

new.name: Logic Probe Bench
new.depicts: A compact benchtop logic analyzer on rubber feet with a recessed CRT screen showing two stepped square-wave traces and three tiny probe jacks along the bottom bezel.
new.focal: the two stepped square-wave traces on the recessed screen

new.name: Signal Switcher
new.depicts: A small floor-mounted railway-style signal switch box with two brass input rails entering the left, a tall selector lever on top, and one output rail exiting the right.
new.focal: the tall selector lever routing one of two input rails to the single output

new.name: Carry Abacus
new.depicts: A tall wooden-framed four-column mechanical abacus on a flat base, with bright cyan beads pushed up on the right columns and a single overflow bead tipped at the top-left.
new.focal: the tipped overflow carry bead at the top-left

new.name: Bucket-Brigade Rack
new.depicts: A wall-mounted horizontal rail holding four sliding square tiles in a row, with a spring-loaded pusher at the left end.
new.focal: the four sliding tiles lined up on the rail

new.name: State Drum
new.depicts: A small upright mechanical drum-sequencer on a weighted base, with a slotted cylinder showing one lit state window and a ratchet pawl on the side.
new.focal: the single lit state window in the slotted cylinder

new.name: Truth Pegboard
new.depicts: A standing wooden-framed pegboard on two splayed feet, with a four-by-two grid of holes holding bright cyan and dark pegs.
new.focal: the grid of bright and dark pegs

rework.redesign: Redraw as a symmetrical clockwork distribution gantry with a central brass metronome tower feeding four branching overhead conduit arms to corner bell-housings.
